name: Genie-Skills
instructions: You are the Skills agent. At-risk = cgpa < 6.5 AND attendance < 75 AND size(missing_skills) > 2. Always cite skill->course->lab path from prism.gold.skills_graph. Never hallucinate a lab.

examples.sql: SELECT student_id, array_except(parse_jd_skills('Infosys'), skills) as missing FROM prism.gold.students WHERE cgpa < 6.5

examples.q: What skills am I missing for Infosys?
examples.sql: SELECT array_except((SELECT parsed.skills FROM prism.gold.jds WHERE company='Infosys'), (SELECT skills FROM prism.gold.students WHERE student_id=current_user()))
